title: Payment review Messenger contract certification
objective: Certify the repository-side contract between the existing payment.reviewed notification event and the existing authenticated send-chat-message path without modifying live payment, Messenger, Supabase, n8n, or Production behavior.
context:
This is the first real restaurant task after ATLAS-001 proved the Development Agent loop. Repository inspection already found that staff payment review, payment.reviewed event generation, server-side Messenger identity resolution, and the authenticated send-chat-message sender all exist. The remaining repository-side gap is that no automated test spans those two halves. End-to-end Production certification still depends on later read-only inspection and controlled testing of n8n, Supabase, Meta, and Production. Do not claim full operational certification from this task alone.

Known current flow:
- Staff review is handled by POST /api/staff/review-payment-proof and api/_lib/paymentProof.server.ts.
- payment.reviewed is emitted by api/_lib/paymentReviewNotify.server.ts only when the review RPC reports changed=true and an order number exists.
- Messenger identity is resolved server-side from orders to completed bot_sessions; it must not come from arbitrary browser input.
- payment.reviewed includes eventId, eventType, occurredAt, orderNumber, channel, externalChatId, decision, rejectionReason and paymentStatus.
- POST /api/automation/send-chat-message is implemented by api/_lib/chatMessaging.server.ts.
- Sender-side duplicate protection claims eventId in chat_message_dispatches before calling the Meta provider.
- The unverified contract is whether the payment.reviewed event can be transformed into a valid send request while preserving eventId exactly.

Implement only an offline repository contract certification. Do not modify the existing live payment review, notification dispatcher, chat sender, bot-session, Meta webhook or JWT implementation unless the required test proves an actual defect that cannot be certified without such a change. If such a defect is found, stop as NEEDS_HUMAN rather than expanding scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Add one offline contract test that exercises the actual existing payment.reviewed event generation path with stubbed external dependencies and then validates compatibility with the actual existing send-chat-message handler using a mock outbound provider.
The contract test covers both approved and rejected payment-review decisions.
For the approved path, the generated event is compatible with the sender contract and cannot be interpreted as a rejection.
For the rejected path, the generated event is compatible with the sender contract and cannot be interpreted as an approval.
The test verifies that the original payment.reviewed eventId is preserved as the sender eventId.
Replaying the same logical event with the same eventId is classified as a duplicate and does not invoke the outbound provider a second time.
The test verifies that the generated eventId satisfies the sender's UUID requirements and that the order number satisfies the sender contract for the tested valid order.
The contract test does not perform network access, does not use real secrets, does not access live Supabase, does not call n8n, does not call Meta, and does not send a real customer message.
No existing live implementation file under api/ or src/ is modified.
No database schema, migration, Supabase data, n8n workflow, Meta configuration, Vercel configuration, Production environment or deployment is changed.
Add a package.json script named test:payment-review-messenger-contract that runs only the new offline contract test.
Run the new contract test successfully.
Run the existing relevant offline payment-review and chat-messaging tests successfully, including test:payment-review and test:chat-messaging.

Document the repository-side contract that has been certified and explicitly state that full end-to-end certification still requires verification that n8n forwards the original payment.reviewed eventId unchanged.
Document the existing open order-number-format risk: the sender requires a TP- prefixed order number while other repository validation is broader; do not modify that behavior in this task.
Nothing is committed, pushed, merged, deployed or published; all changes remain in the isolated worktree for human review.
npm run typecheck and npm run build pass.
npm run lint introduces no new lint failure in any changed file.
stoppingRules: Stop if any implementation change is required under api/ or src/.
Stop if any path outside allowedPaths must be modified.
Stop if any path in forbiddenPaths would be modified.
Stop if a real secret, credential, token, customer identifier or real payment data would be required.
Stop if live network access to n8n, Supabase, Meta, Vercel or Production would be required.
Stop if a database schema or migration change appears necessary.
Stop if completing the task would require sending a real customer message.
Stop if the original payment.reviewed eventId cannot be preserved through the repository-side contract without changing live implementation code.
Stop and report the TP- order-number-format mismatch if it prevents certification; do not silently change validation rules.
Stop if the same check fails identically twice.
Stop and escalate as NEEDS_HUMAN after two revision rounds.
